The Hijrah of the Banu Sulaym Tribe

Hadhrat Salama bin Akwa (RA) narrates that when the Banu Sulaym tribe were affected by an epidemic, Rasulullaah ﷺ advised them to live outside the town. They said, "We dislike to turn back on our heels and return to the outskirts." Rasulullaah ﷺ said to them, "You shall be our country people and we shall be your city people. We shall respond if you call for us and you would respond when we call for you. You will be regarded as Muhaajireen wherever you are." [^2]
The Hijrah of Hadhrat Junaadah bin Abi Umayyah (RA)

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Junaadah bin Abi Umayyaah Azdi (RA)
blocks.text: Hadhrat Junaadah bin Abi Umayyaah Azdi (RA) narrates that there was a difference of opinion amongst them when they made Hijrah during the time of Rasulullaah ﷺ. While some Sahabah (RA) maintained that making Hijrah had come to an end, others were of the opinion that it did not. Hadhrat Junaadah (RA) says that he then asked Rasulullaah ﷺ about this and Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Hijrah shall not come to an end as long as Jihaad is waged against the Kuffaar." [^3]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Sa'di (RA) narrates, "I was the youngest amongst a delegation of seven or eight people from the Banu Sa'd bin Bakr tribe. When the delegation met Rasulullaah ﷺ, they all had their needs fulfilled, leaving me behind to look after the animals. I later approached Rasulullaah ﷺ and said, 'O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Do address my need as well.' When Rasulullaah ﷺ asked me what my need was, I posed the question (to which I needed a reply), 'People are saying that making Hijrah has come to an end.' Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, 'Your need is the best (or he said), your need is better than theirs. Hijrah shall not come to an end as long as Jihaad is waged against the Kuffaar.'" [^4]
What was Told to Hadhrat Safwaan bin Umayyah (RA) and Others Concerning Hijrah

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) narrates that while Hadhrat Safwaan bin Umayyah (RA) was in the upper part of Makkah, he was told that the person who did not undertake Hijrah has no Deen. He therefore said, "I shall never go home until I have first been to Madinah." When he arrived in Madinah, he stayed with Hadhrat Abbaas bin Abdil Muttalib (RA) and then went to see Rasulullaah ﷺ. When Rasulullaah ﷺ asked him what had brought him, he informed Rasulullaah ﷺ that he was told that the person who did not undertake the Hijrah had no Deen. Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "O Abu Wahab!
